decisions.reason: The decision changes physical mounting and connection mode, not the established GPIO assignments for the panel controls or BOOT button.
The inventory already requires connectors for buttons, touch inputs, and reset; clarifying that panel controls use those connectors does not alter the connector inventory.
Panel-control mounting and connection mode do not change the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source decision concerns panel buttons and connectors, not I2C series-resistor population, purpose, or topology.
The INA219 current-monitoring IC and monitored 3.3V rail remain unchanged.
The physical arrangement of panel controls does not affect the main-board power sources or Schottky-diode OR-ing behavior.
The source decision does not change addressable-LED supply voltage, switching, or logic-level handling.
Panel-button placement and connector use do not change standalone USB power activation, capacity, or powered scope.
The referenced connectors are for panel controls, not the power-board-to-main-board power and signal links governed by this requirement.
The panel-control clarification does not affect the charge-status LED chain, CHGLED connector, or associated component values.
The source decision does not change the switched 5V boost supply, its enable GPIO, or its powered loads.
The source decision is unrelated to the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology and net labeling.
